rows.note: For saying how a word or phrase is articulated, this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: I still don't know how to pronounce this English word.
example.traditional: 我仲係唔識發音呢個英文生字。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 hai6 m4 sik1 faat3 jam1 ni1 go3 jing1 man4 sang1 zi6

rows.note: Use this when specifying that a written word or character is read or pronounced as a particular sound.

example.english: You can pronounce this character like the 行 in 行街.
example.traditional: 你可以將呢個字讀做「行街」嘅行。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 ni1 go3 zi6 duk6 zou6 haang4 gaai1 ge3 haang4

rows.note: Use this for an official, authoritative, or ceremonial declaration rather than for saying a word aloud.

example.english: The chair will pronounce the competition officially open at the ceremony.
example.traditional: 主席會喺典禮上宣布比賽正式開始。
example.jyutping: zyu2 zik6 wui5 hai2 din2 lai5 soeng6 syun1 bou3 bei2 coi3 zing3 sik1 hoi1 ci2
